formats.key: deposit(bytes[] pubkeys, bytes[] withdrawal_credentials, bytes[] signatures, bytes32[] deposit_data_roots, uint256[] amounts_gwei)
effects: The signer sends native ETH equal to the sum of amounts_gwei times 1e9 to the Figment depositor; the code reverts unless msg.value equals that sum exactly.
The contract forwards each amount_gwei[i] * 1e9 wei to the immutable Beacon deposit contract, which funds the validator pubkeys[i].
Each deposit binds withdrawal_credentials[i] to the validator, and that decides who can withdraw the staked ETH later.
signatures[i] and deposit_data_roots[i] are passed to the deposit contract as proof and checksum. They move no other asset.
formats.shown: "Stake ETH" with one list each of raw validator public keys, raw 32-byte withdrawal credentials, and per-validator amounts in ETH. The total native value and the signatures are not shown.

findings.title: deposit shows withdrawal credentials as raw 32 bytes, so the signer cannot see who controls the stake.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field {"label": "Withdraw Credentials", "format": "raw", "path": "#.withdrawal_credentials.[]"}. FigmentEth2DepositorV1.deposit forwards withdrawal_credentials[i] to depositContract.deposit, and the natspec says it is 'where rewards will be sent'. Case 0 shows the value 0x0000…0000, and the blind reader was unsure who controls the funds.
findings.fix: Add a field on "#.withdrawal_credentials.[].[12:32]" with format addressName, labelled "Withdrawal address". Keep the raw field so the signer can still see the 0x00/0x01/0x02 prefix.

findings.title: deposit never shows the total ETH sent; the signer must add up the per-validator amounts.
findings.evidence: FigmentEth2DepositorV1.deposit: 'if (msg.value != totalAmount) revert EthAmountMismatch'. The descriptor has no @.value field. Only '#.amounts_gwei.[]' is shown, one entry per validator.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Total stake", "path": "@.value", "format": "amount"} and put it in an interpolatedIntent such as "Stake {total} on {count} validators" (or just the total).

findings.title: deposit shows pubkeys, credentials and amounts as three separate arrays that the signer cannot pair by index.
findings.evidence: Descriptor fields '#.pubkeys.[]', '#.withdrawal_credentials.[]' and '#.amounts_gwei.[]' are separate fields. The contract pairs them by index i in 'cachedDepositContract.deposit{value: amountWei}(pubkeys[i], withdrawal_credentials[i], ...)'. A batch of up to 500 validators shows three long lists.
findings.fix: Add 'in order' to the labels (for example "Validator public key (by index)"), and add the @.value total so the batch can be checked overall.

findings.title: deposit does not show the receiving Beacon deposit contract, which is an immutable in storage.
findings.evidence: FigmentEth2DepositorV1: 'IDepositContract public immutable depositContract;', set in the constructor. Case 0 shows the ETH going to 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa. The blind reader listed 'Which contract receives the ETH' as unsure.

cases.notes: Signer sent 32 ETH out. The screen shows 'Amount to Deposit 32ETH' and it matches. The reader understood the 32 ETH stake, but was confused by the raw all-zero withdrawal credentials.

findings.format: deposit(bytes[] pubkeys, bytes[] withdrawal_credentials, bytes[] signatures, bytes32[] deposit_data_roots, uint256[] amounts_gwei)
findings.title: deposit is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: The contract reverts unless msg.value exactly equals the sum of amounts_gwei × 1e9, and the screen shows each of those amounts (always visible, 9 decimals). So the ETH sent is the amount shown, and it all goes on to the beacon deposit contract. In the mined tx, 32 ETH came in and 32 ETH went to 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa, and the screen said "32ETH". The chain 560048 contract has the same check.
findings.quote: FigmentEth2DepositorV1.sol deposit(): `totalAmount += amountGwei * GWEI_TO_WEI;` … `if (msg.value != totalAmount) { revert EthAmountMismatch(msg.value, totalAmount); }` then `cachedDepositContract.deposit{value: amountWei}(...)`; descriptor.json field {"label": "Amount to Deposit", "format": "unit", "params": {"base": "ETH", "decimals": 9}, "path": "#.amounts_gwei.[]", "visible": "always"}

findings.format: deposit(bytes[] pubkeys, bytes[] withdrawal_credentials, bytes[] signatures, bytes32[] deposit_data_roots, uint256[] amounts_gwei)
findings.title: deposit is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: Both deployments require msg.value to equal the sum of the displayed deposit amounts, so ETH sent is shown through another field. The mined case shows 32 ETH and spends exactly 32 ETH; not-critical item 2 applies.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x8b0d88b8be3c15d746feb0b1f18c883c03b6aa62/src/contracts/FigmentEth2DepositorV1.sol and contracts/560048-0x7ac74cb69104cea773cc3154d47c930ca6462fe8/src/contracts/FigmentEth2DepositorV1.sol, deposit(): `totalAmount += amountGwei * GWEI_TO_WEI;` and `if (msg.value != totalAmount) { revert EthAmountMismatch(msg.value, totalAmount); }`. descriptor.json, deposit fields: `"label": "Amount to Deposit", "format": "unit", "params": { "base": "ETH", "decimals": 9 }, "path": "#.amounts_gwei.[]", "visible": "always"`. cases/0.json, screen: `"label": "Amount to Deposit", "value": "32ETH"`; mined.signerNet: `"amount": "-32000000000000000000"`.
